# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas
{

## Deck Goal
为 ExamOnline 在线考试系统制作一套课程答辩/项目总结型 PPT，清晰展示背景目标、系统架构、数据模型、核心流程、项目亮点、测试部署和后续展望。

## Required Background
{

    "source_summary": "ExamOnline 是基于 Spring Boot + Vue 3 的在线考试系统，覆盖管理员、教师、学生三类角色，支持题库分类、智能组卷、在线考试、防切屏、阅卷、成绩分析和错题本。",
    "core_claim": "系统已经完成从题库建设到考试分析的在线考试闭环，并具备课程项目答辩所需的架构、功能、测试和部署证明。",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Spring Boot 3.3.2",
      "Vue 3 + Vite",
      "Spring Data JPA",
      "H2 / MySQL",
      "题库维护",
      "手动/自动组卷",
      "防切屏自动交卷",
      "自动阅卷",
      "成绩分析",
      "错题本"
    ]
  }
}

## Universal Constraints
- The final image itself must contain the title and key points.
- Render Chinese text exactly and legibly; avoid garbled characters.
- Keep the confirmed deck style consistent while varying layout by slide role.
- No watermark, unrelated logo, or extra slide number.

sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: text-only prompt with fixed deck style brief; no strict source images required
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Use zen-image-api/scripts/generate_image.py with the saved slide prompt; return a blocker if unavailable.
